skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge and skills to identify, develop, and resolve research issues in Information Systems Management.
Manage time and resources effectively, adapt to changes, and communicate professionally.
Write reports and deliver professional presentations on Information Systems topics.
Work independently or collaboratively in groups, demonstrating responsibility and ethical conduct.
Design and develop Information Systems to support operational, managerial, and executive activities in organizations.
Operate and manage Information Systems in organizations.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems in Information Systems.
Self-learn and read specialized literature in Information Systems.
